resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two lookout pages name different forests (St. Joe National Forest; St. Joe / Clearwater National Forest). Both names are kept in the story; we did not pick one.
Idaho Fire Lookouts lists a 1925 staff name before its own 1934 build year. Neither source explains it, so the story flags the gap instead of choosing a date.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on the 1934 build, the 1970 abandonment and the gone status. The 1925 staff entry predates the 1934 build and is flagged in the story. Access is not stated in either source, so access is omitted rather than set. A search for this name also returned sah-archipedia.org (ID-01-021-0030; fetch returned 403) and a Southern Idaho Lookout Mountain Lookout; both are different lookouts and were not used. No new photos found.
